quotes.text: `desktop/backend.mjs` and `desktop/backend-client.cjs` isolate console server, Try monitor, daily build, and phone services; main retains windows, menus, tray, and small IPC. Large Treeherder profiler artifacts under `~/.tb-tools/try-evidence` should use byte caching, not full JSON parsing. Active `tb-task/*` worktrees are intentionally hidden by the main graph, so a task-worktree view/overlay is still needed to surface path, branch, status, and diff. [Task 5]
